name: LOVE alt delete
source:
DATE. DESIGN. DESTROY.

A psychological chat simulator between you and two digital personalities who desperately want to be people. Type keywords to control them, uncover their secrets, and choose their fates.

It's 200X. You are a beta tester for Bicameral, a company that sells MUSEs: glorified chatbots.

Now, they want you to date one.                 

The idea seems straightforward: AI girlfriends for lonely souls, but the NDA you sign makes you wary. Why all the secrecy?

You should know better than to ask questions.

Interact with the digital world through a revolutionary interface: keywords!

You control a chatbot of your own. Pair her up with your digital girlfriend, go on dates together, and maybe snag a kiss, all by typing prompts

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/5080730/]Steam[/url]]
